description.value: Novo is a Kitsilano Italian pizzeria and wine bar serving authentic Neapolitan-style pizza baked in a solid brick oven, made with imported Caputo '00' flour and San Marzano tomatoes grown exclusively for the restaurant in the Naples countryside. House-made fresh pasta, antipasti, a full Italian wine list, and classic cocktails like Negroni and Aperol Spritz round out a substantial meal offering well-suited to cyclists finishing a ride along the nearby Burrard corridor or seawall. Takeout and delivery through Uber Eats and DoorDash provide flexibility for those who want to eat on the go.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at novoitalian.com is active and confirms a full-service Italian pizzeria and wine bar at 2118 Burrard Street, Kitsilano, Vancouver; phone (604) 736-2220 and address are clearly stated on-site but OSM carried no phone. OSM name 'Novo Pizzeria & Winery' conflicts with consistent website branding of 'Novo Italian Pizza & Pasta' / 'Novo Pizzeria' — the business has a wine bar but is not a winery. Takeout is explicitly confirmed on the website; bike parking, washrooms, and most other amenities are not mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name 'Novo Pizzeria & Winery' does not match website branding, which consistently uses 'Novo Italian Pizza & Pasta' or 'Novo Pizzeria'. The business features a wine bar but is not a winery; the OSM name tag appears to be inaccurate.
OSM record contains no phone number; (604) 736-2220 taken from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established full-service Italian restaurant in Kitsilano with confirmed address, phone, and website; takeout available and located on the Burrard Street cycling corridor, making it a viable food stop for touring cyclists.
